Supplementary Figure S8 - Determinants of ctDNA shedding in HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancers at baseline

David N Brown, Bill H Diplas

Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center

23 June, 2026




Supplementary Figure S8a Forest plot showing the standardized coefficients in a multivariate regression predicting cfDNA aligned HPV-16 read pairs from the combination of ctDNA fraction and patient matched primary tumor HPV copies at baseline.




Supplementary Figure S8b Stepwise regression model with backward elimination using AIC shows that the number of cfDNA aligned HPV-16 read pairs in plasma is a function of the combined ctDNA fraction and primary tumour HPV copies.




Supplementary Figure S8c Forest plot showing the standardized coefficients of select transcriptomic signatures, clinical parameters, imaging, and genomic covariates in the multivariate regression predicting ctDNA fraction obtained from the PCM at baseline.




Supplementary Figure S8d Scatter plot comparing the standardized coefficients of the two multivariate regression models predicting baseline cfDNA aligned HPV-16 read pairs (x-axis) versus baseline ctDNA fraction (y-axis) using select transcriptomic signatures, clinical parameters, imaging, and genomic covariates.
